items.title: Italy reports a record 993 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 58,038 and surpassing the previous record of 919 new deaths recorded on March 27.
Hungary reports a record 182 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 5,324.
At least 804 people are dead or missing in the Philippines as a result of Typhoon Durian with the death toll expected to rise further.

Typhoon Nanmadol slams into the island of Luzon in the Philippines, less than a week after tropical depression locally called "Winnie" caused landslides and floods in the region also affected by the earlier typhoons Muifa and Merbok. Floods and landslides by Winnie killed at least 495 persons.
